adjudication_summary.note: Adjudicator errors: Rodriguez 'Wake Forest' is the initial+surname bug (true outcome unknown); Chen 'switched specialty' comes from the wrong NPPES match (true outcome unknown); transfer-in rows set entry year to the arrival year (Raychaudhuri 2013, Nunna 2021, Tariq 2023, Burton 2015, Hoang/Ziu 2017) - PGY-derived entries are 2008, 2018, 2019, 2012, 2012, 2014.

problems: All phase-1 failed Common Crawl reads were retried and succeeded (no new rosters). Shared-adjudicator bugs affect this program: Rodriguez mislabeled TRANSFERRED (Wake Forest) via initial+surname match; Chen mislabeled SWITCHED SPECIALTY via wrong NPPES match; transfer-in start_year used as entry year. Other programs' records to update (not written by this agent): Stanford (61) transfer-out row for Hoang 2017 -> Missouri; Wayne State (125) outcome for Tariq -> Missouri 2023; Dartmouth (18) transfer-in row for Makler 2017.
terminal_pgy_note: 7-year program throughout (ACGME); no length change. 'Chief Resident, PGY 6' label in 2019-20 is a chief title on a PGY-6, not a 6-year track.

2011-2012.reason: No roster exists (muhealth list ends 2011-04, medicine.missouri.edu/neurosurgery starts 2013-11; CC has nothing before 2013-20). Cohort-2011 entrant Jayarao (at BU/BMC research to 2010, NPI 2008) is PGY-3 in 2013-14, and Raychaudhuri's arrival (2011-13) and the departures of pre-window residents Brantl and Muzinich fall in the window, so an unseen 2011 intern replaced within 2011-13 cannot be excluded.

2012-2013.reason: Same as 2011-12: no roster; 2012 entrant Konakondla first seen PGY-2 Jan 2014. The Jan-2014 roster is full (one per PGY 1-7), which limits but does not exclude unseen movement.

2014-2015.reason: Wayback 2014-12-24; Jayarao/Konakondla departures timed by 2015 captures.

2015-2016.reason: Wayback 2015-11-27; no PGY-5 (Jayarao's slot, he left for Geisinger).

2017-2018.reason: Common Crawl 2018-02-20; PGY-7 and PGY-5 slots empty, explained by Konakondla and Rodriguez departures.

2018-2019.reason: No roster (CC-MAIN-2019-09 retried: landing page only). All 8 residents placed: 5 bracketed; Burton and Hoang confirmed at Missouri by 2018 papers and Hoang at Cincinnati by Sep 2019; Kennamer is the only 2018 entrant (possible alternative: joined 2019 at PGY-2 after a prelim, which would mean a vacant or unseen 2018 intern slot).

2020-2021.reason: No roster (CC-MAIN-2020-50 retried: landing page only). Travers (papers to May 2021) and Ziu (Mayo by Jan 2022) as PGY-7; Khan's NPI was enumerated Apr 2020 in Columbia MO (2020 intern). Only Kennamer's exact exit (Jul 2020 vs Jun 2021) is unknown.

2021-2022.reason: No roster (CC-MAIN-2021-49 retried: no captures). Nunna at Missouri by Jan 2022 (arrival mid-year); Ravipati's NPI May 2021 Columbia MO (2021 intern); all other classes bracketed. Complement 1/yr leaves no room for an unseen intern.
